topics.name: DWH Schema Migration Identity
topics.purpose: Define each schema migration as an explicit canonical identity linking exact source and target schema versions, declared transformations and acceptance criteria.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant migration has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.source_rule: Migration references exact source schema identity/version.
semantics.target_rule: Migration references exact target schema identity/version.
semantics.direction_rule: Forward and reverse/rollback migrations are separate explicit semantics.
semantics.transformation_rule: Field/relation/data transformation operations are explicit refs.
semantics.criteria_rule: Preconditions, validation criteria and postconditions are explicit.
semantics.ownership_rule: Migration does not transfer domain ownership away from the schema owner.
semantics.authority_rule: Migration definition visibility does not grant execution authority.

invariants.rule: Schema evolution is an explicit versioned migration between exact schema identities/versions with validated compatibility and data transformation provenance; runtime/file order never silently changes active data meaning.

hard_gates.condition: migration inferred only from version number difference

references.purpose: DWH migration specializes explicit schema evolution.
